MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 9, 2025
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55946  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, November 14, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55949  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of Ethics and
  Transparency – Annual update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55952  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City Attorney’s Office –
  Brown Act.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-56020  Recommendation to endorse the submission to authorize the City Manager, or
  designee, to execute a grant agreement, and any necessary documents, with the
  State of California Department of Parks and Recreation, Division of Boating and
  Waterways, for the Vessel Pump-out Station Grant effective through February 1,
  2026, to accept and expend grant funding in an amount not to exceed $16,499.70;
  authorize a 25 percent cash or in-kind match requirement of $5,499.90; execute
  any future documents, including amendments, necessary to accept, implement, and
  administer the agreement. (Districts 1, 2, & 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55969  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding non-profit slip rate.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 9, 2025
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

6.  24-55947  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-55953  Recommendation to review and discuss the 2025 calendar and agenda items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-55948  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau office at (562) 570-3215 by noon
the day prior to the meeting.
